title: Wretched is the revolution and the revolutionaries!
summary: Editorial condemning the Syrian revolution and the post-Assad government under Ahmad al-Sharaa (al-Julani), labelled a tyrant, as apostate for aligning with France and the Crusader West. It cites al-Sharaa marking the French evacuation anniversary, the reopening of French schools, a recent Macron visit, and the presentation of a free Syria as a partner and friend of Western powers and Trump's America. It argues past anti-French boycotts over insults to the Prophet were superficial, since genuine rejection of France means repudiating its secular laws and creeds rather than its consumer goods. The editorial frames the French presence as an intellectual invasion that corrupts religion and reduces Syria to an energy and transit corridor serving foreign interests, and it links French hostility to Islam from the metropole to the African Sahel. It further disparages a Taliban delegation to Iran and names Khamenei, extending its apostasy charge to rival jihadist and state actors.
keyClaims: The Syrian revolution's leadership under al-Sharaa has apostatised by aligning with France and the Crusader West.
Marking the French evacuation anniversary, reopening French schools, and hosting French officials prove the revolution was never Islamic in aim.
Genuine rejection of France means repudiating its secular laws and creeds, not merely boycotting its products.
The French presence constitutes an intellectual invasion and reduces Syria to a corridor for foreign energy and economic interests.
France's hostility to Islam extends from the metropole to the African Sahel.
significanceAssessment: Standard IS delegitimisation of HTS-governed Syria, sharpened by the France angle to bind a local rival to colonial and Sahelian frames IS already exploits. It signals continued prioritisation of undermining al-Sharaa's legitimacy over operational claims. The linkage of Syria to France's Sahel record is consistent with IS efforts to present a single Crusader campaign across theatres.
notes: Editorial page 3 only. Date cross-checked: 24 Muharram 1448 AH equals Thursday 9 July 2026, consistent with the Thursday masthead. Some lower-column Arabic is small and partially compressed; core argument fully legible.
